**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **§14 (p0079)** gives Client a one-sided termination-at-will right on written notice, effective the last day of the month following the notice month (~30–60 days), with **no early-termination fee or penalty** — at or above our preferred position.
- **§13 (p0078)** sets a 1-year auto-renewing term; TrueLink's only exit is the **mutual 30-day non-renewal notice at end of term** plus for-cause termination of §§2–3 on Client breach. No Vendor mid-term convenience right, so the walk-away scenario doesn't arise.
- Noted, not flagged: no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees (immaterial — §5(a) bills monthly in arrears), and the end-of-term non-renewal notice is 30 rather than 90 days (symmetric, and preserves our own flexibility).
